style: Warm 2D storybook cartoon of an Indian village, soft shading, rounded friendly characters, rich festival colours; Ganesh ji always shown with devotion and respect.

characters.name: Dadi
characters.look: 70-year-old grandmother, white hair in a bun, round gold glasses, cream saree with maroon border, small red bindi, gentle smile
characters.voice_desc: Rani speaks slowly in a warm, gentle and loving voice like an old grandmother telling a bedtime story. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: त्योहार आने वाला था और उसके पापा दिन-रात मिट्टी के दीये बना रहे थे। पापा बहुत थक गए थे।

characters.name: Pari
characters.look: 9-year-old girl, short bob hair with a pink clip, pink frock with green border
characters.voice_desc: A young girl speaks with a high-pitched, sweet and excited voice at a moderate pace. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: यह छोटा दीया मेरे पापा की मदद करेगा। इसमें मेरा बहुत सारा प्यार है!

characters.name: Monu
characters.look: 6-year-old boy, short messy hair, sky-blue kurta and white pyjama
characters.voice_desc: A young boy speaks with a high-pitched, playful and excited voice at a fast pace. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: यह छोटा दीया मेरे पापा की मदद करेगा। इसमें मेरा बहुत सारा प्यार है!

characters.name: Golu
characters.look: 10-year-old chubby boy from Rampur, spiky hair, orange vest and khaki shorts
characters.voice_desc: A young boy speaks with a high-pitched, energetic and cheeky voice at a moderate pace. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: यह छोटा दीया मेरे पापा की मदद करेगा। इसमें मेरा बहुत सारा प्यार है!

characters.name: Meena
characters.look: 10-year-old girl from Shyampur, long single plait, green ghagra and yellow choli
characters.voice_desc: A young girl speaks with a high-pitched, clear and confident voice at a moderate pace. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: यह छोटा दीया मेरे पापा की मदद करेगा। इसमें मेरा बहुत सारा प्यार है!

characters.name: Baba
characters.look: kind old man with a big round belly, big ears, gentle eyes, red tilak, yellow turban, saffron shawl, cream dhoti, cloth bag of modaks, small brown mouse on his shoulder (Ganesh ji in disguise)
characters.voice_desc: Rohit speaks slowly in a deep, calm, kind and soothing voice. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: अरे वाह! मिठी बेटा, तुम्हारे प्यार भरे दीये ने तो पूरे गाँव में उजाला कर दिया!

characters.name: Ramdin
characters.look: Rampur headman, big curled moustache, red turban, white kurta, brown waistcoat, wooden stick
characters.voice_desc: Aman speaks loudly and quickly in an angry, gruff voice. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: अरे मेरी नन्हीं मिठी! तुम तो बहुत छोटी हो। तुम आराम करो बेटा।

characters.name: Shyamlal
characters.look: Shyampur headman, thin, grey beard, green turban, white kurta and dhoti
characters.voice_desc: A middle-aged man speaks loudly in an irritated, sharp voice at a fast pace. The recording is very clear and close-up, with no background noise.
characters.ref_text: हूँ-हूँ! इस नन्हें दीये में मिठी का सच्चा प्यार भरा है। यह दीया सबसे ख़ास बनेगा!

characters.name: Mooshak
characters.look: small brown mouse with pink ears and a long tail, carries a modak
